findings.reason: The protected SQLite adapter performs a correlated smaller-id search for every row. With no email index, its query plan repeats growing primary-key range scans and measured about 1.44 seconds on 8,192 paired rows, versus about 5 ms for the candidate's single grouped-minimum pass.

The branch previously claimed O(n log n), but the immutable MySQL self-join and aligned SQLite correlated query have an O(n^2) worst case under the declared schema. The required bound now states that honest acceptance boundary; the staged candidate improves it to O(n log n).

The performance tiers now use 32, 96, and 192 Person rows so a correct nested repeated-work control completes every output yet is rejected only by scaling (+1.45 relative exponent and 36.13x largest ratio), while the grouped-minimum candidate passes all three tiers.

The protected app-local and Accepted native sources remain untouched and retain their hash-bound SQLite-versus-MySQL alignment review. The candidate is inert, uses the same minimum-id survivor contract, and is not submission evidence.
